recherche-propos: Magnifier, input, then a cross to clear — or the arc when the answer takes its time. The cross is a 48 px button, not a clickable pictogram.
recherche-saisie: With input — the cross clears and returns focus to the field
recherche-chargement: Waiting — the arc replaces the cross
recherche-libelle: Search for a term, a document, a room
recherche-indication: Search for a term, a document, a room
champ-propos: The label always sits above: placeholder text disappears at the first keystroke, and the person no longer knows what they are filling in.
champ-code-aide: Received from the IFDD or in your group.
champ-code-erreur: This code is not recognised. Check the eight characters.
champ-note: The error is said three times: the red border, the pictogram and the sentence that says what to do. The time field carries its 110 px width, which follows its content and not the screen's taste.
zone-propos: 120 px tall, counter under the input. The counter is not a live region: re-read at every keystroke, it would drown out dictation.
zone-valeur: The sitting began twenty minutes late; the chair announced a resumption at 15:00 in room 9.
zone-aide: An IFDD expert checks it before it is shown to others.
zone-restitution: What to remember from the sitting
zone-erreur: This section cannot be left empty.
case-propos: The whole 56 px row is the target, never the 24 px square alone. The box is a real browser checkbox, hidden under its label.
interrupteur-propos: When on, it carries a tick in its knob: in bright sunlight, or for someone who reads green poorly, colour alone says nothing.
cercle-propos: A single choice in a list of rows. The component carries the whole group: one tab stop, and the arrow keys move from option to option.
cercle-corrige: Marked quiz — the options stay readable, no longer changeable
cercle-quiz-libelle: Which body adopts the decisions of the Conference of the Parties?
partage-personne: No one — I keep it to myself
reponse-c: The Conference of the Parties itself
reglage-propos: The whole row is the target, never the chevron alone. With no destination, it carries its control at the end of the line.
reglage-note: A switch placed inside a settings row takes “in row”: the label stops appearing twice, but it remains the announced name of the control. The last row of a block has no rule — the block ends by itself.
